description: A 1-line running header ('Chapter 4: Results — Page N') sitting only 15pt below the header-band cutoff (top=775pt >= 736pt/92%-of-800) but just 5pt above the body block below it -- well under the 16pt/2%-of-800 body-gap threshold classify_regions requires to call it detached. The single-page geometric rule correctly declines it (it looks like the body's own first line), so only repeated-content detection across the 3 consecutive pages (same normalized text, same page-relative y-position, differing only by the page-number digit) can recognize it as a running header. Each page's body block is tall and textually distinct, so it must stay `text` and not get swept up by the repetition signal.

lines.text: This section reports quarterly revenue growth across all four operating regions in detail.
